items.title: Olav tilbyr en ny løsning for alle med små leiligheter: – Sykkel tar plass!
items.summary: Felgen sykkelverksted er det eldste av sitt slag i Oslo. Og i over 20 år har de holdt til på Sagene. Nå er det imidlertid litt andre tider.

items.title: Over 90 familier ville se denne villaen: – Forelsket
items.summary: Nordberg-villaen endte med å bli solgt langt over prisantydning.

items.title: Meta fined $25bn for 'lies' over user data privacy
items.summary: The fine is the largest to date against Facebook's owner, larger than an $18bn deal with California.

items.title: Angry scenes and protests at Senedd as Reform call for ban on Muslim face coverings
items.summary: Members of Reform called for Muslim religious face coverings, such as the burka, to be banned.

items.title: Real Madrid dominate Leipzig for third straight win
items.summary: Real Madrid maintain their 100 per cent start in the Champions League as they comfortably beat Leipzig 4-1, with Bernardo Silva scoring his first goal for Madrid since moving from Manchester City in the summer.

items.title: Missiles hit Kyiv after Russia agrees to US call to resume Ukraine peace talks
items.summary: Moscow says it is "ready in principle" to resume peace talks and US President Donald Trump says the world is "the closest we've been" to ending the war.

items.title: Villa maintain perfect Champions League start with Viking victory
items.summary: Aston Villa win their third game from three in the Champions League by defeating Norwegian side Viking - the dominant display taking them up to second in the league phase.

items.title: Rice strikes to earn Arsenal draw at Bayern
items.summary: Declan Rice scores a late equaliser as Arsenal and Bayern Munich play out an entertaining draw in the league phase of the Champions League while Bukayo Saka limps off with an early injury.

items.title: PSG come out on top in six-goal thriller against Barcelona
items.summary: Desire Doue, Lamine Yamal and Vitinha score superb individual goals as Champions League holders Paris St-Germain overcome Barcelona in a breathless encounter at Parc des Princes.

items.title: Foden nets hat-trick as Man City beat AEK Athens
items.summary: Phil Foden scores a sublime hat-trick as he produces a virtuoso display to help Manchester City return to winning ways in the Champions League group phase by easing past Greek side AEK Athens.

items.title: Mac Allister scores twice as Liverpool fight back to beat Villarreal
items.summary: Rio Ngumoha provides the spark as Liverpool come from two goals down to beat Villarreal at Anfield in the Champions League.

items.title: Man Utd humbled by four-goal Como to pile pressure on Carrick
items.summary: Manchester United suffer a heavy defeat to a Como side playing just their third ever game of Champions League football, as Nico Paz stars for the hosts to pile the pressure on Michael Carrick.

items.title: Arsenal slo tilbake mot Bayern – Ødegaard-assist i 2-2-kamp
items.summary: Bayern München snudde kampen, men Declan Rice scoret målet som sørget for 2-2 i mesterligaen. Arsenal unngikk dermed sitt første tap i CL-sesongen. Napoli og Lille ble slått i de to første kampene. Martin Ødegaard hadde assist på Arsenals ledermål, men Harry Kane og Bayern ledet 2-1 etter en times spill. Etter 82 minutter kom Rice gjennom i feltet
